name: [💰] Grow a Crypto Farm
desc:
💬Welcome to Grow a Crypto Farm! 💻⛏️

Buy powerful machines, place them on your plot, and watch the money roll in!

🔧 How To Play:
• 🛒 Buy Machines from the Shop
• 🧱 Place them in your base
• ⚡ Power them up and start mining Coins!
• 💰 Collect coins regularly, and sell it for cash to expand your operation
• 🏆 Upgrade your machines, unlock new tech, and dominate the world!

Remember, your farm literally earns while you are offline ⭐

🐛
